subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: Where a push channel adapter is present, the wake channel shall treat its deliveries solely as schedule-now hints — the same reads run, the same signals deliver — and an absent or dead push adapter shall change no behavior except latency.
rationale: the reserved slot (WR-1): push may never carry decisions or become load-bearing
fit_criterion: with a stub push adapter: a delivery only advances the next check; killing the stub mid-drill leaves behavior byte-identical at timer cadence
